title: Moving to a new flat
dictation: Last month my sister [[decided]] to move to a new flat. She had been looking for one [[since]] the summer. The flat is small, but it has [[a]] lovely balcony. Her friends [[helped]] her carry the boxes upstairs. Now she spends every evening painting [[the]] walls and choosing furniture. She says she will [[never]] move again, because it is too [[exhausting]]. I think she [[will]] change her mind.
